deals.evidence: Approximately 197,200 shares have been sold thus far in 178,402 transactions, raising more than $65,400,000
deals.headline: Packers' sixth stock sale raises more than $65.4 million for Lambeau Field
deals.summary: The sixth public stock sale, at $300 a share (no dividends, no repayment), opened 16 Nov 2021 and ran to 25 Feb 2022; on its last day about 197,200 shares had been sold in 178,402 transactions, raising more than $65.4 million for Lambeau Field projects (new video boards, concourse upgrades). The final total is not on the page.

name: Green Bay Packers
notes: The Packers publish an annual financial report (fiscal year to 31 March) but the 2026 release (24 Jul 2026) gives no total revenue: it states an operating loss of $1.1m, $133.6m non-operating income, $132.5m net income, record national revenue of $453.2m and a $701m corporate reserve fund. Total revenue and value are therefore Forbes estimates for the 2025 season (list of 9 Sep 2026, via Wayback). FY2024-25 operating profit was $83.7m (packers.com, 23 Jul 2025). The stock-sale amount is the figure stated on the closing day ('more than $65,400,000'), not a final total. Ed Policy succeeded Mark Murphy as chairman, president and CEO in July 2025 (NFL.com). Attendance and social counts not found on a citable page.

ownership_summary: Publicly owned nonprofit corporation (Green Bay Packers, Inc.) since 1923: about 5.2 million shares held by 538,967 stockholders, none receiving dividends; governed by a board of directors and a seven-member executive committee. The NFL's only community-owned club, so no private-equity or institutional stake is possible.
